label: Wetland
description: Marsh, swamp and bog landforms as hero subjects — water and land refusing to choose.

items.name: reed-labyrinth
items.text: a vast reed bed parted by winding open-water leads, head-high stems silver with seed in the wind

items.name: cypress-swamp
items.text: a flooded cypress swamp, buttressed trunks and woody knees rising from tea-dark water, spanish moss hanging dead still

items.name: peat-bog
items.text: a raised peat bog quilted red and green with sphagnum hummocks, early-summer cotton grass tufting white between dark pools

items.name: salt-marsh-creeks
items.text: a salt marsh veined with branching tidal creeks at low water, exposed mud banks shining like poured pewter

items.name: sawgrass-sheet
items.text: a sawgrass plain flooded ankle-deep to the horizon, tree-island hammocks floating in the heat shimmer

items.name: oxbow-lilies
items.text: an oxbow lake looped beside the river that abandoned it, waterlily pads tiling the still arm

items.name: soda-lake
items.text: a soda lake crusted white at its rim and stained flamingo-pink across the shallows, heat shimmer doubling the horizon

items.name: igapo-flooded-forest
items.text: a blackwater forest in flood season, tea-dark water risen ten meters up the trunks until the canopy becomes an archipelago, fish rising to fruit falling from the crowns

items.name: heath
items.text: open heath in flower, low heather running purple to the horizon, gorse in scattered clumps and a peat path cut through
items.text_short: open heath running purple to the horizon
